scope: Ford Maverick car 1970-1977 (US). Mercury Comet and the 2022+ Maverick pickup excluded.
source_counting_note: All Ford brochures and Car Facts count together as ONE manufacturer source. The Wikipedia articles count as ONE. conceptcarz and maverick.to are supplemental.

sources.name: NHRA Stock Car Classification Guide
Ford 1970 Maverick brochure (and revised edition), specifications page

Wikipedia - Ford Maverick (1970-1977), plus Ford straight-six / Ford small block application lists

1970.note: Ford brochure gives 4200 rpm, Chilton 4400 rpm; hp agrees. The 170 was the only engine offered with the semi-automatic transmission in 1970.
